package registration

import (
	"context"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/viant/datly/bootstrap"
	adapter "github.com/viant/datly/handlerfixture/adapter"
	business "github.com/viant/datly/handlerfixture/business"
	rhandler "github.com/viant/datly/runtime/handler"
	"github.com/viant/datly/spec"
	"github.com/viant/datly/standalone"
	"github.com/viant/datly/standalone/config"
	"github.com/viant/x"
)

const factoryIdentity = "github.com/viant/datly/handlerfixture/business.NewConvert"

func TestAdapterLinkage(t *testing.T) {
	for _, registry := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{false: "holder", true: "registry"}[registry], func(t *testing.T) {
			before := adapter.Constructions.Load()
			contractBefore := business.Constructions.Load()
			var handler rhandler.TypedHandler
			if registry {
				exports := x.NewRegistry()
				require.NoError(t, RegisterConvertFactories(exports))
				require.Equal(t, before, adapter.Constructions.Load())
				_, found := exports.LookupFunction(factoryIdentity)
				require.True(t, found)
				_, found = exports.LookupFunction("github.com/viant/datly/handlerfixture/adapter.LinkedHandler")
				require.False(t, found, "adapter must retain the route's canonical identity")
				builder, err := bootstrap.NewArtifactBuilder(exports)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				artifact, err := builder.Build(artifactInput())
				require.NoError(t, err)
				handler = artifact.Handler
			} else {
				factory := ConvertDatly.DatlyHandler(factoryIdentity)
				require.NotNil(t, factory)
				require.Nil(t, ConvertDatly.DatlyHandler("unknown"))
				require.Equal(t, before, adapter.Constructions.Load())
				var err error
				handler, err = factory()
				require.NoError(t, err)
			}
			require.Equal(t, before+1, adapter.Constructions.Load())
			require.Equal(t, contractBefore, business.Constructions.Load(), "override must not construct generic contract")
			for _, value := range []string{"success", "error", "nil", "panic"} {
				recovered := adapter.Recovered.Load()
				result, err := handler.Execute(context.Background(), rhandler.Invocation{Input: &business.Input{Inclusion: value}})
				if value == "error" {
					require.ErrorIs(t, err, adapter.ExecutionError)
				} else {
					require.NoError(t, err)
				}
				if value == "success" {
					require.Equal(t, "adapter:success", result.(*business.Output).Value)
				} else {
					require.Nil(t, result)
				}
				if value == "panic" {
					require.Equal(t, recovered+1, adapter.Recovered.Load())
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func artifactInput() bootstrap.ArtifactInput {
	return bootstrap.ArtifactInput{
		Component: &spec.Component{Key: spec.Key{Kind: spec.KindComponent, Scope: "github.com/viant/datly/handlerfixture/registration", Name: "Convert"}, Name: "Convert", Routes: []*spec.Route{{Method: "POST", Path: "/convert", Handler: factoryIdentity}}},
		InputType: reflect.TypeFor[business.Input](), OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[business.Output](), HandlerOwnedOutput: true,
	}
}

func TestAdapterRuntimeRejection(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"constructor error", "nil", "typed nil", "mismatch"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			adapter.Mode = mode
			defer func() { adapter.Mode = "" }()
			exports := x.NewRegistry()
			require.NoError(t, RegisterConvertFactories(exports))
			builder, err := bootstrap.NewArtifactBuilder(exports)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			artifact, err := builder.Build(artifactInput())
			require.Error(t, err)
			require.Nil(t, artifact)
			switch mode {
			case "constructor error":
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, adapter.ConstructorError)
			case "mismatch":
				require.ErrorContains(t, err, "contract mismatch")
			default:
				require.ErrorContains(t, err, "returned nil")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestAdapterHolderRuntimeRejection(t *testing.T) {
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, mode := range []string{"constructor error", "nil", "typed nil", "mismatch"} {
		for _, eager := range []bool{false, true} {
			t.Run(mode+map[bool]string{false: "/lazy", true: "/eager"}[eager], func(t *testing.T) {
				adapter.Mode = mode
				defer func() { adapter.Mode = "" }()
				before := adapter.Constructions.Load()
				cfg := &config.Config{BaseDir: filepath.Dir(cwd), GoBootstrap: &config.Packages{Packages: []string{"github.com/viant/datly/handlerfixture/registration"}, EagerComponents: eager, LinkedOnly: !eager}}
				server, err := standalone.New(t.Context(), standalone.Options{Config: cfg, Holders: []any{ConvertDatly}})
				if err == nil {
					defer server.Shutdown(context.Background())
					err = server.Reload(t.Context(), 1)
				}
				if err == nil {
					request := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/convert", strings.NewReader(`{"inclusion":"success"}`))
					request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
					response := httptest.NewRecorder()
					server.ServeHTTP(response, request)
					require.Equal(t, 500, response.Code, response.Body.String())
				}
				require.Greater(t, adapter.Constructions.Load(), before)
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestAdapterHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, mode := range []string{"eager", "indexed", "linked"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg := &config.Config{BaseDir: filepath.Dir(cwd), GoBootstrap: &config.Packages{Packages: []string{"github.com/viant/datly/handlerfixture/registration"}, EagerComponents: mode == "eager", LinkedOnly: mode == "linked"}}
			server, err := standalone.New(t.Context(), standalone.Options{Config: cfg, Holders: []any{ConvertDatly}})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			defer server.Shutdown(context.Background())
			require.NoError(t, server.Reload(t.Context(), 1))
			for _, value := range []string{"success", "nil", "panic"} {
				request := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/convert", strings.NewReader(`{"inclusion":"`+value+`"}`))
				request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				response := httptest.NewRecorder()
				server.ServeHTTP(response, request)
				require.Equal(t, 200, response.Code, response.Body.String())
				if value == "success" {
					require.JSONEq(t, `{"converted":"adapter:success"}`, response.Body.String())
				} else {
					require.Empty(t, response.Body.String())
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
